functionSignature.name: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization
functionSignature.returns: TABLE (authorization_id UUID, command_id UUID, decision_evidence_id UUID, decision_version INT, decision_digest TEXT, reservation_id UUID, cancellation_release_id UUID, paid_bridge_id UUID, payment_attempt_id UUID, provider_origin_kind TEXT, provider_payment_ref TEXT, approved_amount_paise BIGINT, currency TEXT, issuing_role TEXT, issuing_principal TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, replayed BOOLEAN)
functionSignature.security: VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp SET row_security = on
functionSignature.roleGate: Enforces session_user = 'encho_refund_issuer' OR pg_has_role(session_user, 'encho_refund_issuer', 'MEMBER'); raises REFUND_ISSUER_UNAUTHORIZED otherwise
orderingAndGates: 1. Caller validation: verifies session_user has role encho_refund_issuer
2. Input validation: non-null command, reservation, and evidence UUIDs

3. Evidence admission: verifies permitted_issuer_role = 'encho_refund_issuer', permitted_submitting_component = 'REFUND_DECISION_AUTHORITY_PRIMITIVE', classification = 'LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE', matching reservation_id
4. Reservation root lock: SELECT ... FROM canonical_reservations FOR UPDATE
5. Semantic command fingerprinting: SHA-256 over canonical JSONB payload

6. Replay check: returns stored authorization with replayed = true if command matches; raises REFUND_COMMAND_CONFLICT on conflict; raises REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED if reservation/evidence already bound to different command

7. Canonical subject derivation: latest event CANCELLED by INTERNAL_DECISION for ENCHO_DIRECT, unique V1 cancellation release with effective version 1 and revision NULL, matching night counts, zero sealed V2 revisions, COMMITTED paid bridge, APPROVED payable authority with currency INR

8. Reconciliation gates: payment attempt locked FOR UPDATE; state MATCHED_CAPTURE; matched_at NOT NULL; reconciliation_reason IS NULL; zero unresolved payment reconciliations; authority hash matches expected_authority_hash

9. Capture group verification: coherent PROCESSED capture group, unique payment ref and order ref, ceiling >= approved amount > 0, supporting event verified, zero cross-attempt aliases, capture uniqueness check
10. Atomic insertion: inserts into canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations; catches unique_violation for race recovery; returns complete table projection with replayed = false

rolePrivileges.provisioningSemantics: Migration 061 does not CREATE the role encho_refund_issuer; its DO block validates least-privilege properties (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION) and grants USAGE on schema public and EXECUTE on issue_cancellation_refund_authorization only if encho_refund_issuer already exists in the database. When the role is absent, the grant block is safely skipped. The disposable test fixture provisions the role locally for test execution. Production role provisioning is not evaluated.
grants: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO encho_refund_issuer
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION issue_cancellation_refund_authorization(UUID, UUID, UUID) TO encho_refund_issuer

absenceOfExtraPrivileges.tableDml: Migration 061 grants zero table permissions to encho_refund_issuer. In migration validation DO block: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE privileges are checked absent on the two new tables and canonical_reservation_nights; INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE privileges are checked absent on canonical_reservations, canonical_payment_attempts, canonical_payment_reservations, canonical_provider_events, booking_holds, inventory_days, and stays_quotes (global absence of SELECT across existing relations is not claimed). Runtime probes in focused test T03c directly verify 42501 denial on SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE across both new tables.
absenceOfExtraPrivileges.schemaCreate: ZERO CREATE on schema public or current_database()
absenceOfExtraPrivileges.superuser: NOT rolsuper, NOT rolbypassrls, NOT rolcreatedb, NOT rolcreaterole, NOT rolreplication

T01.title: Valid paid V1 cancellation plus admitted synthetic decision returns complete authorization
T01.evidence: Successfully issued refund authorization with replayed = false; all derived bindings match canonical records; verified row persisted in canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations

T02.title: Payable differs from room subtotal: follows payable/capture authority
T02.evidence: 2-night reservation with 1,100,000 paise room subtotal and 1,300,000 paise payable authority; approved amount 1,200,000 paise exceeds room subtotal but remains within captured ceiling; successfully authorized

T03.title: Missing/forged approval, authenticated DB role permission denials, and decision_ref check constraint
T03.evidence: Non-existent evidence rejected with DECISION_EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND; unapproved submitting component rejected by check constraint; unprivileged authenticated database roles (composition worker, payment worker, stays web, reservation worker) denied with 42501 under normal ACLs; issuer direct SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on both new tables denied with 42501; empty string and whitespace-only decision_ref rejected with SQLSTATE 23514

T04.title: Cross-resource evidence and authorization insert rejection
T04.evidence: Independent database triggers reject executable cross-binding substitutions: wrong reservation cancellation release in evidence (RELEASE_RESERVATION_MISMATCH), wrong reservation paid bridge in evidence (BRIDGE_RESERVATION_MISMATCH), and mismatched reservation in owner authorization insert (REFUND_AUTHORIZATION_CROSS_BINDING_MISMATCH: EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH)

T05.title: Natural scope exclusions: ACTIVE/request-only, external, direct-only, and V2 exclusions without disabling triggers
T05.evidence: ACTIVE uncancelled reservation rejected at trigger with CANCELLATION_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND; REQUEST-ONLY reservation rejected with CANCELLATION_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND; direct-finalizer-only rejected with PAID_BRIDGE_NOT_FOUND; external channel reservation rejected with LIFECYCLE_ORIGIN_NOT_SUPPORTED; naturally assembled and sealed V2 reservation cancellation rejected at issuance with V2_CANCELLATION_RELEASE_EXCLUDED; zero triggers or foreign keys disabled

T06.title: Excess approved amount, conflicting capture, unresolved reconciliation, visible cross-attempt alias
T06.evidence: Approved amount > capture ceiling rejected with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE; natural conflicting capture transitions attempt to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and is rejected with PAYMENT_STATE_NOT_MATCHED_CAPTURE; unresolved reconciliation in table rejected with PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED; visible cross-attempt alias rejected with CAPTURE_CROSS_ATTEMPT_ALIAS_AMBIGUOUS without trigger tampering

T07.title: Equivalent duplicate captures yield one ceiling (no summing)
T07.evidence: Two duplicate capture events for same attempt verified in DB; attempting to authorize 2x captured amount rejected with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE; authorizing single captured ceiling succeeds

T08.title: Exact authorized replay after later financial observations on the same payment attempt
T08.evidence: Later conflicting capture ingested on the exact same payment attempt transitions it to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; replaying the original command succeeds with replayed = true returning identical authorization; verified count(*) remains exactly 1 with 0 new rows added; replay with changed semantics rejected with REFUND_COMMAND_CONFLICT; unauthorized caller replay attempt rejected with 42501

T09.title: Concurrency on two real connections: identical race convergence, fresh distinct contention, and cleanup
T09.evidence: T09-pre: configured observer SQL timeout (200ms) verified effective via bounded delayed query SELECT pg_sleep(1) interrupted with SQLSTATE 57014 (query_canceled). T09a (identical commands): Connection A holds open transaction with row lock; Connection B executes identical command concurrently; Connection B is actively observed waiting on Lock with Connection A in pg_blocking_pids before A commits; A commits, B unblocks and completes (one insertion, one recovery replay, exactly 1 row total; unique_violation recovery not inferred as reservation-root serialization may resolve race before insert). T09b (distinct commands): fresh paid V1 cancellation; Connection A holds open transaction with command A; Connection B executes distinct command B concurrently; Connection B is actively observed waiting on Lock with Connection A in pg_blocking_pids before A commits; A commits, B unblocks and is rejected with REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED leaving 0 rows for command B; exact replay of command A returns same authorization with replayed = true; declared scoped existing-domain snapshot is unchanged. T09c (failure cleanup): controlled deliberate observer-failure demonstration verifies that deliberate assertion failure triggers ordered rollback, settles queries, verifies idle status 'I' via getTransactionStatus() before release, leaves zero surviving authorizations, leaves no retained open transactions or active backends, and restores scoped snapshot; caller validator validateT09cNormalSuccess requires zero unexpected cleanup errors; cleanup negative control verifies injected cleanup verification failure is preserved in cleanupErrors and rejected by validator, with actual client disposal and restored scoped snapshot. T09d: sequential distinct command attempt against already-authorized reservation rejected with REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED.

T10.title: Immutability, structured injected rollbacks, and zero domain row mutation across 16 tables
T10.evidence: UPDATE and DELETE rejected on evidence and authorizations tables by immutability triggers (T10C). T10A outer transaction rollback: asserts distinct completed stages (initial complete issuance row, restricted same-transaction replay witness comparing full projection including created_at, and post-witness abort query) before injecting invalid cast SELECT 'intentional_abort'::int (SQLSTATE 22P02); rolls back transaction, leaving zero authorizations for command, zero authorizations for scoped subject, and all 16 scoped canonical domain tables restored; committed negative control exercises identical marker pre-issuance SELECT 'intentional_abort'::int, specifically rejected due to absent stages (STAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED) while preserving underlying 22P02, leaving 0 authorizations and 16 scoped domain tables unchanged. T10B insertion-stage failure: fixture-only BEFORE INSERT trigger raises exact SQLSTATE P7777 / REVIEW_REFUND_AUTHORIZATION_INSERT_FAILURE; rolls back leaving 0 authorizations and 16 scoped domain tables restored. T10C clean issuance: leaves 0 mutations across all 16 scoped canonical domain tables.

trustBoundariesAndLimitations.syntheticEvidenceBoundary: Decision evidence admitted in local testing is explicitly classified LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE with verifying component REFUND_DECISION_AUTHORITY_PRIMITIVE (not DISPOSABLE_TEST_FIXTURE_RUNNER). It remains synthetic evidence and does NOT represent a real founder or human approval.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.missingApprovalRegistrar: Production approval registrar is NOT implemented in this slice. Current schema and check constraint permit LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE only; a future real approval registrar needs a later approved contract and schema change before any real approval classification can be admitted. Zero real human approval is registered or admitted.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroMoneyMovement: This slice authorizes refund intent within the canonical database only. Zero money movement, zero Razorpay/Stripe API dispatch, zero payout execution, zero wallet crediting, and zero ledger settlement occur.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.noRemainingRefundableBalanceAccounting: This slice does not maintain a cumulative refund ledger or remaining refundable balance. Future slices must enforce partial-refund accounting before settlement.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.publicSurface: Zero public HTTP/REST/GraphQL routes or UI elements are exposed. All functionality is internal database routines under role encho_refund_issuer.
